subject: math

objective.text: Break an array into rows or columns. Write a repeated addition equation for the total.

explanations.title: A row is a group
explanations.text: Call each row a group. Write how many are in each row beside it. Then add the numbers. 4 rows of 5 is 5 plus 5 plus 5 plus 5, which is 20.

explanations.title: A column is a group
explanations.text: Call each column a group. Write how many are in each column below it. 5 columns of 4 is 4 plus 4 plus 4 plus 4 plus 4, which is 20.

explanations.title: Rows or columns, same total
explanations.text: 3 rows of 6 and 6 columns of 3 are the same array turned. Both make 18. The total does not change.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (3 rows of 6 and 6 columns of 3)

explanations.title: Add or remove one unit
explanations.text: Add one more column of 4 to 20 and you have 24. Add one more column of 3 to 18 and you have 21. When you take away a row or a column, you take away one unit.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (20 plus 4 is 24; remove a unit)

explanations.title: Count the addends
explanations.text: The number of addends is the number of rows or columns. 4 rows of 5 gives 4 addends: 5 plus 5 plus 5 plus 5.

examples.title: 4 rows of 5
examples.text: Write 5 beside each row. 5 plus 5 is 10. 10 plus 5 is 15. 15 plus 5 is 20. 4 fives equals 20.

examples.title: 5 columns of 4
examples.text: Write 4 under each column. 4 plus 4 is 8. 8 plus 4 is 12. 12 plus 4 is 16. 16 plus 4 is 20.

examples.title: Add one column
examples.text: 5 columns of 4 is 20. Add 1 more column of 4. Now there are 6 columns and 24 beans.

examples.title: 3 rows of 6
examples.text: 6 plus 6 plus 6 equals 18. The same array has 6 columns of 3. 3 plus 3 plus 3 plus 3 plus 3 plus 3 equals 18.

questions.text: An array has 4 rows of 5 beans. Each row is one group. How many equal groups are there?
How many beans are in each group?
Say the repeated addition for 4 rows of 5 beans.
Add the 4 fives. What is the total?
How many addends are in 5 plus 5 plus 5 plus 5?
An array has 5 columns of 4 beans. How many beans are in each column?
Add 4 plus 4 plus 4 plus 4 plus 4. What is the total?
4 rows of 5 beans and 5 columns of 4 beans. Is the total the same?
Add 1 more column of 4 to 5 columns of 4. How many beans are there now?
An array has 3 rows of 6 tiles. Say the repeated addition.
Add 6 plus 6 plus 6. What is the total?
The same 18 tiles are in columns. How many columns are there, and how many tiles are in each column?
Say the repeated addition for 6 columns of 3 tiles.
Add 1 more column of 3 to the array. How many tiles are there now?
Sam puts 8 red cards in 2 equal columns. How many red cards are in each column?
Sam also puts 8 blue cards in 2 equal columns. How many cards are in her whole array?
You add one more row to an array. How does the repeated addition change?

assets_required.why_this_method: Exact object counts, spaced rows or columns, the numbers written beside them, and adding or removing a row or column need exact behaviour. Diffusion cannot count.
assets_required.description: A board of identical objects in an array. Rows or columns can be pulled apart. A number can be shown beside each row or under each column. One row or column can be added or removed.
must_show_exactly: Exactly the object count in the stimulus
Every row has the same number of objects
Every column has the same number of objects
Numbers beside rows or under columns match the objects
Add or remove changes the count by exactly one row or column
states_or_frames: 4 rows of 5 with rows pulled apart and 5 written beside each
8 red cards in 2 columns and 8 blue cards in 2 columns (4 columns of 4)
assets_required.interaction: Tutor sets rows, columns and spacing from the stimulus. Child can add or remove a row or column. Child answers by voice or typing.
assets_required.alt_text: Objects arranged in an array with numbers beside the rows.
assets_required.generation_caption: Flat cartoon beans (or tiles) in an exact grid, a small gap between rows, plain background. [Build by code]
